meta.title: Rome, Sardinia & Paris Summer 2027
meta.dates: July 17 - August 1, 2027 (Miami -> Rome -> Sardinia -> Paris -> Miami, return flight TBD)

route.name: Rome
route.sub: 3 nights · Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum

blocks.title: Drop off rental/curbside check-in at MIA
blocks.detail: Arrive 3+ hrs before an international flight with a family of 4 and bags for a 2-week trip.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA52 - Nonstop - 10h5m
blocks.detail: MIA -> FCO, Economy, 4 passengers. Booked via Alaska Atmos Rewards (partner award on American, oneworld). Lands Sunday, July 18 local time Rome.
blocks.notes: 35,000 Atmos Rewards points + $25.60 per passenger x 4 travelers = 140,000 points + $102.40 total, per the fare shown when searched. Confirm exact per-passenger breakdown at booking.
blocks.flag: Overnight flight - lands 12:05 PM Rome time the next day (Sunday July 18). Kids will have been awake ~16+ hrs by landing; keep Day 2 light.

blocks.title: Land at FCO - immigration, bags, customs
blocks.detail: Budget a full hour-plus for a family of four after an overnight transatlantic flight.

blocks.title: Transfer to hotel
blocks.detail: FCO -> Esquilino district, ~45min-1hr depending on traffic (taxi or private transfer; Leonardo Express train + metro is the budget option but is a lot with luggage and jet-lagged kids).
blocks.notes: Estimate for a private taxi/transfer, ~€55-60 flat rate FCO to central Rome.

blocks.title: Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum - check in
blocks.detail: 2 rooms.
blocks.notes: 70,000 Hilton Honors points/night/room x 2 rooms x 3 nights = 420,000 points total. Standard check-in is typically 3:00 PM - early arrival may mean a wait or luggage storage while rooms are readied.
blocks.roomType: 2 Rooms (confirm bed config - Standard King or Queen/Queen)
blocks.cancelBy: Not yet booked - confirm cancellation policy at booking
blocks.flag: Newly opened property (debuted 2026) - worth a quick recent-review check closer to the date for any post-opening operational issues.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
blocks.detail: Deliberately no anchor activity today given the overnight flight - jet lag buffer.

blocks.title: Dinner - Café Café
blocks.detail: Via Ostilia 23, 00184, ~5 min walk from hotel area toward the Colosseum ring. Casual café-style menu (pasta, sandwiches, salads, smoothies) - easy, low-key first dinner for a jet-lagged family.
blocks.notes: Estimate for a family of 4 at a casual café - 2 mains + 2 kids plates + drinks.

blocks.title: Walk to Colosseum
blocks.detail: ~20 min walk from the Hilton Garden Inn (hotel quotes 20 min; some guest reviews say closer to 15). Departing 8:35 for a 9:00 entry slot.

blocks.title: Colosseum
blocks.detail: First-entry slot to beat heat and crowds - the consistent recommendation for July, and specifically the best window for kids 6-9.
blocks.notes: €18/adult, under-18s free but still require a reserved (no-cost) ticket. Combined Colosseum+Forum+Palatine ticket is standard - one 24-hr ticket covers all three, no separate purchase needed. Official site: ticketing.colosseo.it. IMPORTANT: tickets release on a rolling 30-day window before the visit date - this can't be booked now, needs a calendar reminder for ~mid-June 2027, and July slots sell out weeks ahead.
blocks.flag: Book the instant the 30-day window opens (~mid-June 2027) - July is peak season and official allocation sells out.

blocks.title: Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
blocks.detail: Included on the same Colosseum ticket. Walk through the Forum ruins at a kid's pace - this is the one ancient-history block for the whole Rome stay, kept to a single morning rather than spread across multiple days.

blocks.title: Lunch - Trattoria Vecchia Roma
blocks.detail: Via Ferruccio 12B, 00185 (Esquilino, near hotel). Carbonara, amatriciana, carciofi alla giudia, pizza - real menu variety, outdoor seating, family-friendly per reviews. Open Mon-Sat 12:30-3/7-11pm (closed Sundays, so today - Monday - works).

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
blocks.detail: Real buffer after a big morning on foot in July heat - no second anchor activity today.

blocks.title: Dinner - Naumachia
blocks.detail: Via Celimontana 7, 00184, steps from the Colosseum/San Clemente. Mixed Roman + Tuscan menu - pasta, seafood, meat, some pizza. Open daily 11am-midnight.

days.title: Historic Center - Pantheon, Trevi, Piazza Navona

blocks.title: Metro Line A - Manzoni to Barberini
Walk from Barberini to Trevi Fountain
Trevi Fountain
blocks.detail: Free to view from the piazza; as of Feb 2026 there's a new €2/person fee for the close-up basin-level viewing area (9am-10pm daily). Best light and smallest crowds are the morning window we're hitting.
blocks.flag: The €2 close-up fee is a very recent (Feb 2026) policy - reconfirm it's still in effect/same price closer to 2027.

blocks.title: Pantheon
blocks.detail: Free entry, under-18s free regardless. Open 9am-7pm. A compact, low-fatigue-risk stop for kids.

blocks.title: Walk to Piazza Navona
blocks.detail: ~400-500m via Via Giustiniani -> Corso del Rinascimento.

blocks.title: Piazza Navona
blocks.detail: Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers, street performers, open space for kids to move after a morning of walking. Free, open-air.

blocks.title: Gelato - Frigidarium
blocks.detail: Via del Governo Vecchio 112, 1-2 min from Navona. Artisan gelato since 1988; signature 'Frigidarium' flavor (cream/chocolate/Pan di Stelle).

blocks.title: Lunch - Il Barroccio
blocks.detail: Via dei Pastini 13/14, 00186, near the Pantheon. Cacio e pepe, carbonara, rigatoni pancetta e pecorino, bruschetta, tiramisù - casual and affordable. Open daily 11:30am-11pm.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
blocks.detail: Metro back to Manzoni, then downtime - real buffer before the flight to Sardinia tomorrow. Start packing.

blocks.title: Dinner - Emma Pizzeria
blocks.detail: Via del Monte della Farina 28, 00186, near Navona. Despite the name, a genuinely varied menu beyond pizza - stuffed zucchini, carbonara, artichoke salad, cured meats/cheeses. Open daily 12:30-3pm & 7-11:30pm. Reservations recommended.

blocks.title: Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum - check out
AeroItalia (rep.) - Nonstop - 1h05m
blocks.detail: FCO -> OLB, Economy, 4 passengers.
blocks.notes: 2027 summer schedule not yet published. FCO-OLB currently runs ~8 nonstop flights/day (7:50am-10:20pm) on AeroItalia and Volotea, ~1hr flight time. Picked a representative late-morning slot; re-confirm and book once 2027 schedules are released.

blocks.title: Pick up rental car - Olbia Airport
blocks.detail: Olbia airport has Avis, Hertz, Sixt plus local/budget operators (Green Motion, Surprice, Centauro). July rates run roughly $38-59/day depending on operator and how early booked.
blocks.notes: Estimate: ~$48/day average x 7 days (Jul 21-28) = ~$340. Needed for the week: La Maddalena departs from Palau (1h6m away), Ispinigoli cave is in Dorgali (1h20-1.5h), and Porto Cervo is 1h6m - the resort shuttle only covers La Cinta beach. Book well ahead; July is peak season and cars sell out.
blocks.flag: Skip the resort's paid airport-transfer option (€80/vehicle) - picking up the rental at the airport covers that leg for free since the car is needed for the whole week anyway.

blocks.title: Drive to San Teodoro
blocks.detail: ~27 km / ~25-27 min from Olbia airport.

blocks.title: Terradimare Resort & Spa - check in
blocks.detail: Family room, near La Cinta beach and dunes.
blocks.notes: Estimated at $350/night x 7 nights = $2,450. This is a midpoint estimate for July peak season - the hotel's blended-year average is ~$150/night, so treat $300-400/night as unconfirmed until checked directly against the live July 2027 rate.
blocks.flag: Price is an estimate, not a quote - confirm live rate before booking.

blocks.title: Settle in / La Cinta beach
blocks.detail: Light first afternoon - beach steps from the resort, no structured plans.

blocks.title: Dinner - Griglieria da Simona
blocks.detail: Grilled meats and porceddu (Sardinian roast suckling pig) to order - casual, easy first-night choice.

blocks.title: La Cinta beach & dunes
blocks.detail: La Cinta's dune-and-lagoon system, right by the resort. No structured plans - real beach/nature morning.

blocks.title: Lunch - Beach Club La Cinta
blocks.detail: Right on La Cinta beach. Carbonara, seafood pasta, tuna tataki, casual beachfront service.

blocks.title: Dinner - Karjasa Restaurant Private Garden
blocks.detail: Family-run, raw seafood, catch-of-the-day blackboard, fregola/risotto/octopus, garden setting. Open daily 6pm-midnight.

blocks.title: Drive to Palau
blocks.detail: ~68 km / ~1h6m via Olbia/Arzachena.

blocks.title: La Maddalena Archipelago - full-day boat trip
blocks.detail: Delfino Tours, 'Archipelago Excursion - 4 Stops', departs Palau. Stops: Spargi, Santa Maria, La Maddalena town, and a slow pass of Budelli's Pink Beach (landing prohibited to protect the ecosystem) with swimming at the Natural Pools/Porto della Madonna area nearby.
blocks.notes: 2026 high-season pricing (Jul 6-Aug 3, covers our dates): Adult €65, Child 4-10 €50 -> ~€65+€65+€50+€50 = €230 for the family (~$248). Food/drinks not included - bring a packed lunch or buy on board/at a stop. Contact +39 334 852 0671, gitearcipelago.it/en/excursions-la-maddalena-prices
blocks.flag: Confirm exact 2027 departure/return times directly with Delfino Tours closer to booking - generic tour length is '7+ hours,' typically ~9:30am-5pm, but no published exact daily schedule for 2027 yet.

blocks.title: Change / rinse off at the hotel
blocks.detail: Dedicated changeover block after a full day on and in the water.

blocks.title: Dinner - L'Ea Cana
blocks.detail: Via Nazionale 18. Sardinian land & sea - Gallurese soup(skip for kids), culurgiones, roasted porceddu, shrimp with figs & bottarga, seadas.

blocks.title: Drive to Dorgali
blocks.detail: ~84-95 km / ~1h20-1h30 via Olbia, SS125. (Neptune's Grotto near Alghero was ruled out - it's ~2h45-3h each way from San Teodoro, not realistic with kids. Ispinigoli is the same 'real cave, real nature' experience at a fraction of the drive.)

blocks.title: Grotta di Ispinigoli
blocks.detail: A show cave with a 38m stalagmite column - one of Europe's tallest - and the 'Abisso delle Vergini' sinkhole. Guided tours run hourly 10am-5:45pm (last tour).
blocks.notes: €8/adult, €4/child (4-10). ~$26 for the family. Managed by the Ghivine cooperative.
blocks.flag: Aggregator sites showed conflicting weekday-closure info - verify current hours directly at grottaispinigoli.com before finalizing the day's timing.

blocks.title: Lunch - Ristorante Ispinigoli
blocks.detail: At Hotel Ispinigoli, right next to the cave. Michelin-listed, panoramic terrace over the Gulf of Orosei. Degustation menus €48 (meat) / €55 (fish); à la carte also available.

blocks.title: Pool / beach - free time
blocks.detail: Recovery time after a driving-heavy day - no second anchor.

blocks.title: Dinner - Ristorante Pizzeria Simbiosi
blocks.detail: Via del Tirreno 26. Despite the name, the menu centers on land/sea dishes (tagliolini with cuttlefish ink is the standout) with pizza as one option, not the whole menu.

blocks.title: La Cinta beach
blocks.detail: Free morning - no anchor.

blocks.title: Dinner - Ambàra Sardinian Lounge
blocks.detail: Monte Petrosu. Mediterranean/international, tapas-style tasting, vegetarian/vegan options.

blocks.title: La Cinta beach
blocks.detail: Free morning - no anchor.

blocks.title: Dinner - Lu Brutoni Ristorante e Vineria
blocks.detail: Center of San Teodoro. Local sea & land ingredients, à la carte or 7-course tasting option. Open 7-11:45pm.

blocks.title: La Cinta beach - last full beach morning
Porto Cervo marina - evening stroll
blocks.detail: Compact luxury marina town, yacht-watching, boutiques - light evening activity rather than a full day trip given the drive.

blocks.title: Dinner - Belvedere, Porto Cervo
blocks.detail: Daily fish display case, informal dining room, genuinely family-welcoming despite the glossy setting.
blocks.notes: Book well in advance once dates are locked - Porto Cervo restaurants fill up fast in July.

blocks.title: Last La Cinta beach morning
blocks.detail: Light morning before the airport - swimsuits until the last possible moment.

blocks.title: Drive to Olbia Airport, return rental car
Volotea (rep.) - Direct - 2h05m
blocks.detail: OLB -> Paris Orly (ORY), Economy, 4 passengers.
blocks.notes: Summer-seasonal direct route (Volotea/Transavia France/easyJet), ~2h05m. Picked a representative afternoon slot; confirm the route is still operating and book an actual flight once summer 2027 schedules are released.

blocks.title: Transfer to hotel
blocks.detail: Orly to the 14th arrondissement (Left Bank), ~30-40 min by taxi/RER.

blocks.title: Paris Marriott Rive Gauche - check in
blocks.detail: Family Suite.
blocks.notes: Estimated at $400/night x 4 nights = $1,600. Marriott's own listing shows cash rates 'from $181' but that's a low-end/off-peak rate class, not a July peak Family Suite figure - treat as a placeholder pending a live quote.
blocks.flag: Price is an estimate, not a quote - confirm live July 2027 rate before booking.

blocks.title: Dinner - Brasserie, Paris Marriott Rive Gauche
blocks.detail: On-site brasserie, French classics + international staples - zero transit needed after a full travel day.

blocks.title: Walk to Saint-Jacques metro station
blocks.detail: ~200m from hotel.

blocks.title: Metro Line 6 - Saint-Jacques to Bir-Hakeim
blocks.detail: Direct, no transfer, ~12 min, trains every 5 min.

blocks.title: Eiffel Tower - 2nd floor by elevator
blocks.detail: 2nd floor (not summit) is the better call for kids 6-9 - full panoramic views, much shorter lines, no wind/altitude exposure, roughly half the price. Timed e-ticket required.
blocks.notes: 2026 pricing (verify 2027 figures): 2nd floor by elevator, child under 12 ~€7.40, adult full price - budgeting ~€60/$65 for the family. E-tickets open exactly 60 days ahead at ticket.toureiffel.paris - flag for booking around late May 2027, July sells out same-day.
blocks.flag: Book at the 60-day mark (~May 30, 2027) - this is a hard booking-window constraint, not optional lead time.

blocks.title: Walk to Port de la Bourdonnais
Seine River Cruise - Bateaux Parisiens
blocks.detail: Departs Port de la Bourdonnais, right at the foot of the tower. ~1hr, individual audio guide, departures every 30 min.

blocks.title: Lunch - Le Casse-Noix
blocks.detail: 56 rue de la Fédération, 75015, near the Tower. French bistro, seasonal menu. Open Mon-Fri only (today, Thursday, works) 12-2:30pm/7-10:30pm.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
Dinner - I Grappoli
blocks.detail: 22 Place Denfert-Rochereau, 75014, ~7 min walk from hotel. Italian trattoria - pizza and pasta, real menu variety. Open daily noon-midnight.

blocks.title: Metro Line 4 - Denfert-Rochereau to Château Rouge
blocks.detail: ~23 min, no transfer - the best route to Montmartre from this hotel.

blocks.title: Funicular up to Sacré-Cœur
blocks.detail: Accepts a standard metro ticket, ~90 seconds, runs 6am-12:45am - much easier than the steep stairs with kids.

blocks.title: Sacré-Cœur exterior & parvis
blocks.detail: Exterior/viewpoint only, consistent with skipping museum/interior visits. Arriving before 10am to beat the crowd build that starts around 11.

blocks.title: Place du Tertre - artists' square
blocks.detail: Best before 10-11am, before it's shoulder-to-shoulder.

blocks.title: Wander down via rue Lepic
blocks.detail: More charming than retracing the funicular, and doubles as the day's buffer/walk.

blocks.title: Lunch - Chez Plumeau
blocks.detail: 4 Place du Calvaire, 75018, steps from Place du Tertre but sheltered from the main tourist flow. ~€15/dish avg, terrace with city views. No reservations - arriving right at open to avoid a wait.
blocks.flag: No-reservation policy - plan to arrive close to opening.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
Dinner - Le Relais Gascon
blocks.detail: 6 rue des Abbesses, 75018 (Montmartre). Southwest French classics (cassoulet, duck), giant salads - family-friendly, open daily noon-midnight.

blocks.title: Walk to Luxembourg Gardens
blocks.detail: Budget ~20 min from the hotel/Saint-Jacques area (sources ranged 10-25 min - confirm exact door-to-door time closer to the trip). RER B from Denfert-Rochereau to Luxembourg (2 stops) is the fallback if anyone's tired.

blocks.title: Ludo Jardin playground
blocks.detail: Gated children's play area inside the gardens - burning energy early before the wander.

blocks.title: Luxembourg Gardens
blocks.detail: Pond with rentable toy sailboats, seasonal pony rides, carousel, main gardens wander.
blocks.notes: Toy sailboat rental is a few euros - small optional spend.

blocks.title: Latin Quarter wander
blocks.detail: Exit north toward Rue Mouffetard, Panthéon exterior, Sorbonne area - kept as low-key strolling, not stacked sightseeing.

blocks.title: Lunch - Le Choupinet
blocks.detail: 58 Blvd Saint-Michel, 75006, directly across from the gardens. Brasserie - croque-monsieur, tartare, escargot, full menu variety. Open 8am-2am daily.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel, pack
blocks.detail: Last full day - real buffer before travel logistics resume tomorrow.

blocks.title: Dinner - Brasserie, Paris Marriott Rive Gauche
blocks.detail: On-site again deliberately for the last night - easy and close given tomorrow's return-flight logistics are still TBD.

blocks.title: Paris Marriott Rive Gauche - check out (next morning)
blocks.detail: Checkout is actually the morning of Aug 1 - listed here as a reminder for packing/logistics on the last evening.

blocks.title: Paris -> Miami return flight - not yet booked
blocks.detail: Left open per request. Nonstop options exist: Air France or Delta from CDG (~9hrs), or French bee from Orly (~9hrs, 3x/week).

items.name: Confirm Terradimare Resort & Spa July 2027 family-room rate
items.note: Blended-year average rate is ~$150/night off-peak; the $300-400/night figure used here is an estimate for July peak season, not a live quote. Confirm directly with the hotel or a booking site before treating it as fixed.

items.name: Confirm FCO -> OLB flight number/time for July 21, 2027
items.note: 2027 schedules aren't published yet. Used a representative flight based on the current pattern (AeroItalia/Volotea, ~8 nonstop flights/day, ~1hr). Re-check once the airline releases summer 2027 schedules.

items.name: Confirm OLB -> Paris Orly flight number/time for July 28, 2027
items.note: This is a summer-seasonal direct route (Volotea/Transavia/easyJet, ~2h05m). Confirm the route is still operating for summer 2027 and lock in an actual flight.

items.name: Book Paris -> Miami return flight
items.note: Left empty per request. Nonstop options exist on Air France and Delta (~9hrs) from CDG, or French bee from Orly.

items.name: Confirm Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum is fully operational
items.note: Newly opened property (2026 debut). Worth a quick check for post-opening issues closer to the trip.

items.name: Book Colosseum + Forum tickets
items.note: Releases on a rolling 30-day window before the visit date - book around mid-June 2027 (not before), and do it the day the window opens since July sells out fast.

items.name: Book Eiffel Tower tickets
items.note: Releases 60 days ahead - book around May 30, 2027, same-day if possible.

items.name: Verify RER C status for any future Versailles day
items.note: RER C had a confirmed summer 2026 closure between Paris and Versailles for works; not currently built into this itinerary, but if added later, re-check 2027 status and default to Transilien Line N from Gare Montparnasse instead.
